newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - June 26.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - June 26.

text.p: The following stories appeared in Thursday's Daily Variety:
* The new CBS TV station group chief Mel Karmazin promised a group of Wall Street investors he would turn around the poorly performing unit as soon as the third quarter of this year.
* The original concept of a pilot as the first episode of a new series is becoming almost obsolete as fewer actually make it onto the air.
* Rupert Everett, who plays Julia Roberts' gay best friend in TriStar's "My Best Friend's Wedding," is in talks to become Hollywood's first gay secret agent.
* Michelle Manning has been named president of production for Viacom's Paramount motion picture group.
* Hollywood producers are banding together to make sure only those movie producers who deserve credit get it.
